'''Ramook''' was an [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] located just beyond the far end of the [[Chiloon Rift/Legends|Chiloon Rift]].<ref name="Crucible (novel)">[[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']]</ref>

In [[45 ABY]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ben Skywalker]] was investigating the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] for signs of [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]], a [[Sith Meditation Sphere]] controlled by [[Vestara Khai]], a former member of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]].<ref name="Crucible (novel)" />
